name: adlib-api
description: Node.js and TypeScript SDK for the AdLib API: one REST API for the public ad libraries of Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest and X, with ad history, watchlists and webhooks.
author: AdLib

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs dist && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/write-cjs-package.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/clean.mjs build-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke
